_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY, NOT APPROVED (approved is false). Small stage: one m7i.xlarge, deadline_mode managed (an AWS-managed one-time EventBridge Scheduler schedule created and read back right after launch, plus the host's own shutdown timer), $1 ceiling for ONE attempt: 90 min plus 30 min margin. Prices are the owner's verified inputs (gp3 $0.08/GB-month, IPv4 $0.005/h, scheduler priced at $1 per million with NO free-tier deduction); the worst case is about $0.5295 before tax and support; this is not a hard billing cap and not a zero-cash guarantee. The role named below must be created by the owner from `awsctl plan` output; awsctl never creates it. The role, the schedule and any account change need separate owner approval, not yet given.
image_id: OWNER: resolve again at launch time. Observed at the live read: ami-0d6dd9e8265d48906 (Canonical Ubuntu 24.04 amd64, ubuntu-noble-24.04-amd64-server-20261023, owner 099720109477, no product codes, root /dev/sda1 EBS 8 GiB gp3 plus two ephemeral template mappings)
